Marathon Petroleum Corporation - Providing Energy Solutions
Providing Energy Solutions
At Marathon Petroleum, we're in the business of enhancing life's possibilities.
See How We Do It
Come Join a Winning Team
The diverse backgrounds and perspectives of our people help make our company
a great place to work
. Learn more about our opportunities to move your career forward.
Apply Now
Speedway’s consumer data security efforts get attention
To combat fraud and better protect your data, Speedway has invested more than $130 million in new pump technology. This investment has put Speedway at the forefront of the convenience store industry.
LEARN MORE ABOUT SPEEDWAY'S EFFORTS
A Leading Energy Company
Marathon Petroleum is a leading, integrated, downstream energy company. We operate the nation's largest refining system, are one of the largest midstream operators in North America, and have a nationwide retail and marketing business.
Download Our Annual Report
2018 and 2019 ENERGY STAR® Partner of the Year
Marathon Petroleum received the Environmental Protection Agency's (EPA) annual award in 2018 and 2019 for our progress to increase energy efficiency across all operations. Since the EPA began that program in 2006, we've been recognized more than all other U.S. refiners combined. Marathon Petroleum is the only petroleum refining company to earn the award in 2018 and 2019.
Learn Why
Our Values
We promote diversity and inclusion. We back worthy community causes. We save energy, reduce emissions and preserve wildlife. All while providing products that make people's lives better.
